scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:app -w @kanjime/mobile && npm run build:app -w @kanjime/admin
scripts.build:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run build:app -w @kanjime/admin
scripts.build:android: npm run build:shared && npm run build:android -w @kanjime/mobile
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run build:app -w @kanjime/mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint:shared && npm run lint:mobile && npm run lint:admin
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:admin: npm run test:shared && npm run test -w @kanjime/admin
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:all:admin: npm run test:shared && npm run test:all -w @kanjime/admin
scripts.test:all:mobile: npm run test:shared && npm run test:all -w @kanjime/mobile
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:mobile -- && npm run test:e2e:admin --
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:shared && npm run test:integration:app -w @kanjime/mobile && npm run test:integration:app -w @kanjime/admin
scripts.test:integration:admin: npm run test:shared && npm run test:integration:app -w @kanjime/admin
scripts.test:integration:mobile: npm run test:shared && npm run test:integration:app -w @kanjime/mobile
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:shared && npm run test:unit:app -w @kanjime/mobile && npm run test:unit:app -w @kanjime/admin
scripts.test:unit:admin: npm run test:shared && npm run test:unit:app -w @kanjime/admin
scripts.test:unit:mobile: npm run test:shared && npm run test:unit:app -w @kanjime/mobile
